items.title: Unit 2 · They're happy now!
items.scene: Sometimes I am happy. Sometimes I am sad. Sometimes I am nervous. But I am never bad. When I'm really happy, I smile and laugh and play. When I'm really happy, it's a very good day. When I'm really sad, I cry and tell my mum. We always talk together, then happy times can come. When I'm really nervous, I'm brave and carry on. I say, 'I can do it!' until my nerves are gone. Sometimes I am happy. Sometimes I am sad. Sometimes I am nervous. But I am never bad.
